map.由每期付款、利率与期数求期初年金现值 使用指南: Annuity Due Present Value from Periodic Payment, Rate and Periods User Guide
map.输入每期付款 PMT、每期利率 r 与期数 n，按期初年金求现值 PV，用于评估: Enter the payment per period PMT, the periodic rate r and the number of periods n, and compute the present value as an annuity due, for valuing cash flows paid in advance.
map.PV=PMT×[1−(1+r)^(−n)]÷r×(1+r)，期初年金每笔提前一期: PV = PMT x [1-(1+r)^(-n)]/r x (1+r); in an annuity due each payment occurs one period earlier and is discounted one period less, so the present value is higher than an ordinary annuity with the same parameters (such as a mortgage payment).
map.评估房租、保费等期初付款现金流的当前价值。: Evaluate the current value of advance-payment cash flows such as rent and insurance premiums.
map.租赁方案现值测算。: Present Value of a Leasing Plan.
map.对比期初与期末年金现值差异。: Compare the difference between annuity due and ordinary annuity present values.
map.每期 1,000、月利率 0.5%、12 期期初年金现值: Annuity Due with 1000 per period, 0.5% monthly rate, 12 periods
map.由免税品种收益率与税率求税后等效收益率: After-tax equivalent yield from tax-free yield and tax rate
map.期初年金现值为什么高于期末？: Why Is an Annuity Due Higher Than an Ordinary One?
map.每笔付款提前一期发生，折现期数少一期，故现值更高。差额约为一期利息的现值。: Each payment occurs one period earlier and is discounted one period less, so the present value is higher. The difference is roughly the present value of one period's interest.
map.和房贷月供现值的关系？: How Does It Relate to the Present Value of Mortgage Payments?
map.房贷月供是期末年金（月初放款、月末首次还款），用普通年金现值；房租是典型期初年金: A mortgage payment is an ordinary annuity (disbursed at the start of the month, first payment at month end), so use the ordinary annuity present value; rent is a typical annuity due, and the two formulas differ by one (1+r) factor.
